text: Psal. 104. 5. prou. 30.4. , Heb. if thou knowest vnderstanding.
Heb. sockets. , Heb. made to sinke.
Or, established my decree vpon it.
Heb. the pride of thy waues.
Or, the seuen-starres. Heb. Cimah. , Heb. Cesil.
Or, the twelue signes. , Heb. guide them.
Heb. who can cause to lie downe.
Or, when the dust is turned into myre. , Heb. is powred.
